remarks: Welcome to this bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom condo located in the heart of Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood. This unit features a well-designed layout with a large living and dining area, an updated kitchen, and generous closet space throughout. This end-unit comes with a gas fireplace, tons of natural light from the additional windows, and has beautifully maintained hardwood floors. Both bedrooms are well-sized, including a primary suite with an en-suite bath. Enjoy private balcony access and garage parking, along with on-site laundry and additional storage.   Conveniently located near Glenbrook Train Station, downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, and I-95-perfect for commuters or those seeking low-maintenance living in a central location. Schedule your private showing today!
